text:
Mia: Hey — heads up I'm connecting LHR -> MAN with ~55m between flights on the same PNR. Any quick checklist or panic advice? Arriving T5 gate B, ETA 14:35, departs 15:30. :sweat_smile:
Sam: If it's the same ticket you're probably OK but 55m is tight. If your bag is checked that's the big risk. Call the airline desk now to confirm transfer rules. :grimacing:
Luca: Quick practical checklist:
- Get a seat near front when boarding (ask at gate if you can move)
- Don't check bags
- Tell the FA you have a tight connection so they'll prep you
- Skip duty free & dawdling
Jen: Also download the terminal map and mark where passport control/security are. If you can buy Fast Track/security pass do it now. Apps show live walk times for Heathrow.
Mia: Good call. Any passport-control tricks? I'm UK passport holder so hoping eGates help.
Sam: If you have an eGate-eligible passport USE IT. Otherwise aim for the non-EU lanes appropriately. If you're not eligible, try to join a shorter family/priority lane if allowed.
Luca: If you've got Global Entry / Registered Traveller, great. If not, keep boarding pass + passport out and move toward the scanners as soon as you disembark.
TravelBot: Flight status & terminal resources: https://www.heathrow.com/arrivals | live flight tracker: https://flightaware.com
Mia: Any micro-pack tips? What to keep in carry-on so I can run?
Jen: Essentials only: passport, phone + charger, boarding passes, wallet, headphones, tiny snack. Put them in the top compartment so you can grab quickly. If you must check, at least put a change of clothes in carry-on.
Sam: If gate changes or delays ping ground staff immediately and ask for interline transfer help. If the connection is missed due to delay on the airline's side ask for rebooking and overnight voucher if applicable.
Luca: For posterity, here's my silly emergency checklist code block:
```
- passport
- phone + cable
- powerbank
- boarding pass x2 (pdf + app)
- wallet
- small snack
- lightweight jacket
```
Mia: Thank you all — feeling marginally less panicked. Will report back after landing. :raised_hands:
Jen: Safe run — hope you make it! :crossed_fingers:
Sam: Ping us if you need help with rebooking or checking alternate flights. Happy to jump in.
